info.name: Extract PDF of receipts associated to an Expense Report

params.name: voucherInvoice
params.description: Voucher invoice number.

params.name: reportID
params.description: The Report ID is a 12-digit number generated by Chrome River that begins with 0100. Be sure to omit the dashes.

params.name: getMileageDetails
params.description: If selected, PDF will include mileage details, including map and distance, if expense was created using Maps

params.name: getImage
params.description: If selected, PDF will include receipt images attached to the report

params.name: getPDFReport
params.description: If selected, the original PDF is retrieved first, if available.

params.name: getPDFReportWithNotes
params.description: If selected, the original PDF will include approval notes

params.name: imageFirst
params.description: If selected, the images will be retrieved before any PDFs

items.docs: This method returns a PDF file of all the images associated with an Expense Report or with the line items within the report.

info.name: Extract PDF of receipts associated to an Expense Report with a CoverPage

params.name: voucherInvoice
params.description: Voucher invoice number.

params.name: reportID
params.description: The Report ID is a 12-digit number generated by Chrome River that begins with 0100. Be sure to omit the dashes.

items.docs: This method returns a PDF file of all the images associated with an Expense Report and includes a CoverPage.
